decision_question: Can exact DFlash produce useful 15-token parallel drafts for the exact Gemma 4 31B target while preserving greedy target/KV semantics and beating matched AR and NGRAM component throughput at c32?
causal_hypothesis: One five-layer DFlash forward amortized across 15 proposals will save enough exact-target decode work to increase accepted target tokens per combined component second over both controls.
expected_direction: DFLASH > AR and DFLASH > NGRAM in accepted target tokens per host component second, with identical greedy output token IDs.

controls.stock: Exact target autoregressive decode with identical target bytes, source, precision, workload, observer, page size, and H200.
controls.distinct: SGLang NGRAM with the same exact target, block size 16, workload, observer, and H200.
controls.candidate: SGLang DFLASH with exact public draft revision and block size 16.

identities.hardware: nvidia-h200-sxm; exact UUID supplied by the later director execution binding

correctness_gate.request_pool_mapping: ForwardBatch.rids[row] is logical identity; ForwardBatch.req_pool_indices[row] selects target_worker.model_runner.req_to_token_pool.req_to_token.
next_round_audits: pending target bonus becomes the next current token
new committed length becomes the next prefix length
committed KV prefix digest remains stable
zero, partial, and full prior acceptance categories are each represented

performance_gate.cuda_accounting: Per-round CUDA-event interval union across draft, target verify, acceptance, and KV commit; intervals are unioned before summing rounds.
performance_gate.endpoint_promotion_plausibility: At least 25% component throughput over the best control is the conservative throughput equivalent of a 20% time reduction; a matched endpoint remains a separate gate.

slo.availability: No request errors and all three fresh c32 arms complete.
slo.semantic: Exact target greedy output identity and all KV/bonus audits pass.
slo.claim_scope: Component only; no endpoint or production claim.

budget.owner_deadline: Supplied by a later director and bounded by the active lab watchdog with retrieval/release reserve.

stop_rules.close_revision: Immutable model/shape load incompatibility, target/KV semantic failure after bounded repair, or DFlash component throughput no better than both exact controls.
stop_rules.promote_endpoint: All semantic gates pass, mean accepted drafts is positive, DFlash beats both controls, and the component margin makes a 20% endpoint reduction plausible.
stop_rules.small_positive: Record as stackable component evidence without endpoint promotion.
stop_rules.repair: Ordinary launcher, observer, path, import, retrieval, or summarizer defects retain the claim and replay only an unconsumed invalidated scope.

teardown: Stop sequential arm containers, retrieve and hash compact evidence, then generation-fenced release. Available only when quiescent; maintenance for unsafe/unreachable or absolute-deadline boundaries.
